pattern: Build compactly as SUBJECT -> ACTION ANCHOR -> BODY/ORIENTATION -> LIMB RELATION -> CAMERA only if justified -> EXPRESSION/GAZE if useful -> MOTION/FLUID/DEPTH details -> ENVIRONMENT. Never turn the action into a sentence when a compact observed anchor exists.
Keep identity/appearance separate from framing and lighting. Prefer one framing control plus a small purposeful lighting/effect set instead of a quality wall.
Keep subject counts/global scene in base prompt. Put per-character identity/outfit/action into character prompts; preserve directed interaction separately.

State the environment first-class rather than only saying 'detailed background'. Add blurry background/depth of field only when they support the requested depth relationship; do not automatically add bokeh.
